note: Stable codes: a code names a rule and is never renumbered or reused. Message text is not part of the contract and may differ between languages. Generated from src/framework/diagnostics by npm run contracts.

prefixes.DP-ENV: doctor: author and consumer environment checks

codes.summary: Not inert finite JSON: a non-finite number, a non-JSON value, a cycle, a prototype key (__proto__, prototype, constructor) or text that does not parse as JSON.
JSON structure budget exceeded (depth above 24 or more than 500 000 nodes).
More than 1 MiB of compact UTF-8 JSON.
An object is required at this position.
A field the schema does not declare (additionalProperties: false).
A required field is absent.
format is not "datapass.artifact".
version is not 1.
Not an id (^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]{0,79}$, not constructor/prototype/__proto__).
Not a string, too many Unicode code points, or blank where text must be filled.
Not an integer within the allowed range.
Not one of the allowed values (provenance kind, producer kind, column type, chart).
An array is required at this position.
A list has fewer or more items than allowed.
An id list (dependsOn, representation inputs) repeats an id (uniqueItems).

inputHash is not 64 lowercase hex characters (sha256).
An input value is not a finite number, a boolean or a string of at most 400 characters.
column.nullable is not a boolean.

npm cannot be found or does not report a version.

The ResultStore folder (--results-dir or DATAPASS_RESULTS_DIR) is inside a Git work tree.
Another tab or writer saved the workspace after this tab loaded it; nothing is written until the user keeps theirs, keeps mine or exports both.
The revision sidecar is missing, unreadable or does not describe the stored document (an older studio or an unknown writer saved it).
The other writer's workspace failed validation, so it was not taken; this tab and the conflict are unchanged.

A file entry has an unknown or duplicate path, an unknown media type, extra keys or text that is not well-formed UTF-8.

runs.json, inputs.json, lineage.json or at least one artifacts/<id>.json file is missing.

A run, input set or lineage entry names an artifact, path, hash or run that the bundle does not contain.

A file would contain the in-memory runtime token; the export is refused before any byte is written.

kind is not one of artifact-ref, run-receipt, selection-binding, approval-request, parameter-diff.
An object in the record has a key its kind does not define.

A field has the wrong JSON type, pattern, range or list length.
A digest is not {alg: sha256, over: bytes | datapass-c14n/1, value: 64 lowercase hex} or an artifact sha256 is not 64 lowercase hex.

Run status, timestamps and cancelRequested contradict each other (order, missing start/finish, cancelled without a request).
model.resolved is null without a reason, or a reason is given while the resolved model is known or absent.
A check is both performed and not performed, or a parameter is in more than one coverage list.
